query:
SELECT id, shareCode, address, reportType,
  JSON_LENGTH(reportData, '$.comparables') as comp_count,
  JSON_KEYS(reportData) as all_keys,
  LENGTH(reportData) as data_size,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.marketId') as marketId,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.historicalData') IS NOT NULL as has_historical,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.marketInsights') IS NOT NULL as has_market_insights
FROM universal_shareable_reports
WHERE shareCode = '2v9cjmVa9k';
